title: Occult Practices
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Occult practices are forbidden attempts to seek power, guidance, hidden knowledge, or spiritual control apart from God. Scripture calls God’s people to reject these practices and seek Him through His Word.
summary: Occult practices are forbidden attempts to seek power, guidance, hidden knowledge, or spiritual control apart from God. Scripture calls God’s people to reject these practices and seek Him through His Word.
christFocus: Jesus Christ is the true Lord and Shepherd of His people. Believers do not need occult guidance or hidden power because Christ leads, protects, and rules them by His Word and Spirit.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture forbids occult practices because they seek spiritual help apart from God. Divination, sorcery, spiritism, mediums, and attempts to control hidden powers are incompatible with trust in the Lord.

Occult practices are not harmless curiosity. They turn people from God’s Word toward forbidden spiritual sources and open the door to deception, bondage, and rebellion.

In Acts, those who turned to Christ openly renounced magic practices. The Gospel calls people not merely to add Jesus to old spiritual practices, but to turn from darkness to the living God.

God’s people are called to seek direction from Him. Scripture, prayer, wisdom, and the Holy Spirit’s guidance replace the fear-driven desire for secret knowledge or spiritual control.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people turn to occult practices because they feel afraid, desperate, curious, or hungry for control. Scripture shows that those paths do not bring life.

This doctrine is important for protecting believers from spiritual compromise. Christ is sufficient, and His people must not seek forbidden power while claiming to trust Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Reject occult practices completely. Do not seek guidance from mediums, divination, astrology, spells, tarot, spirit communication, or hidden powers. Confess any involvement to God, turn to Christ, remove what belongs to darkness, and seek wisdom through Scripture, prayer, and faithful believers.
